pages.text: The $(l)Steam Box$() softens a $(l)Rough Limb$() with heat and moisture, turning it into a $(l)Pliable Limb$() that can actually be strung into a bow.$(br2)Fuel it, load your rough limbs, and let them steam.
Craft a Steam Box to make your limbs pliable.
With a Pliable Limb, a $(l)Riser$() and a $(l)String$() in hand, head to the $(l)Fletching Table$() to assemble, and tune: your bow.
